title: a long timeout (ten minutes): Ferret's window waits and the page's own abort still ends it with AbortError

unsafe.definition: an error type or a time that tells the page whether Ferret has a passkey for it (no match against cancelled)

note: The browser path ends a request with nothing to offer at once (NotAllowedError); in Ferret's window it waits and the page's abort ends it.
